description.text: Main courses Sketch for Designers,Color for Designer,Landscape Painting,3DModeling,Oil Painting,Animation Techniques of Fashion Art Drawing,Design of Clothing Structure,Computer Designing,Fashion Art and Craft Fasion Design. Fees Health Insurance: 600 Yuan/year Medical Examination: 535 Yuan/year Residence Permit: 800 Yuan/year Living Cost (food): 1000 Yuan/Month Books: It depends on the program. Accommodation Fee: Hostel (single room A): 1200 Yuan/Mon Hostel (single room B): 900 Yuan/Mon Hostel (single room D): 4000 Yuan/year Student dorm (4 students persons share one room): 2500 Yuan/year

duration.text: The Arts Design at Ningbo University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.The application form can be downloaded from the website, please fill in the form according to the corresponding requirements and attach your photo to it 2.The photocopy of your high school diploma and transcript

requirements.text: 1. Over the age of 18 and hold a valid foreign passport. 2. High school graduate.
